verdicts.title: SceneMotifCoder: Example-driven Visual Program Learning for Generating 3D Object Arrangements
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Despite advances in text-to-3D generation methods, generation of multi-object arrangements remains challenging. verdicts.title: Structural Causal Models for Extremes: an Approach Based on Exponent Measures
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce a new formulation of structural causal models for extremes, called the extremal structural causal model (eSCM).
